title: Sandbox a Third-Party Widget
prompt: Embed a chat widget (https://chat.example.com/widget) that needs scripts and form submission only: iframe with sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms", a title, loading="lazy", and explicit width/height. Then, below it, embed a trusted static report from YOUR OWN origin as <iframe src="report.html" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin"> (safe because it is first-party).

tests.name: untrusted widget is least-privileged
tests.hint: Least privilege: scripts + forms are the stated need; same-origin, top-navigation and popups are not.

tests.name: widget has a name and dimensions
tests.hint: An unnamed frame announces only 'frame'; lazy loading without dimensions also causes layout shift.

tests.name: first-party report keeps its origin
tests.hint: Trust is the criterion: first-party content may keep its origin; third-party never does.

tests.name: lazy where it belongs
tests.hint: Third-party embeds are prime lazy-loading candidates — off-screen frames should not cost bytes.
